title: $3000 Chinese Carbon Road Bike After 500 Miles // In-Depth Review!

takeaways.text: The carbon integrated bar and stem look great but routing the cables through it was a pain.
His size-52 build with Shimano 105 hydraulic, 50 mm carbon clinchers and 32 mm tires weighed 8.79 kg.
He runs 32 mm tires, the official maximum, for comfort on UK roads and sees no need to change them.
Acceleration is sharp and descending planted; climbing is fine but not climbing-bike light, and the thick top tube only rarely touches his knees out of the saddle.
The 380 mm bar with 90 mm reach makes it very agile and, with 50 mm rims, sensitive to gusts.
The complete build cost him about £2,389 (US$3,000) in 2023.

disclosure: The owner says he paid about US$3,000 for his build; no sponsorship is stated.
summary: An owner's 500-mile review of a size-52 Elves Falath EVO (2023) built with Shimano 105 hydraulic, 50 mm carbon wheels and 32 mm tires.
